param_space.description: Runtime-safe sweep space for Tier 4 short cosmology smoke loops. Parameters map directly to existing key=value entries in params.txt and do not require recompilation.

constraints.name: max_total_cells
constraints.reason: Prevent long runtimes and oversized smoke outputs.

constraints.name: cubic_grid_only
constraints.reason: Reduce sweep entropy in Phase 1 and keep geometry consistent.

constraints.name: gamma_positive_constraint
constraints.reason: Required by runtime checks in initial condition setup.

constraints.name: omega_sum_near_unity
constraints.reason: Keep cosmology parameters physically consistent for smoke runs.

constraints.name: positive_omega_b_less_than_matter
constraints.reason: Preserve a physically plausible baryon fraction.

param_space.name: tier4_smoke_param_space_v0

parameters.name: nx
parameters.notes: Grid size in x. Kept small to preserve short smoke runtime.

parameters.name: ny
parameters.notes: Grid size in y. Keep aligned with nx/nz for stable tiny-box sweeps.

parameters.name: nz
parameters.notes: Grid size in z. Upper bound chosen to keep total cells small.

parameters.name: Init_redshift
parameters.notes: Narrowed in Phase 1 to reduce low-value exploration noise.

parameters.name: H0
parameters.notes: Hubble parameter used by cosmology initialization.

parameters.name: Omega_M
parameters.notes: Matter density parameter; constrained with Omega_L and Omega_b.

parameters.name: Omega_L
parameters.notes: Dark-energy density parameter; constrained with Omega_M.
